"''It looks like they're going to Three Hundred next, but there's no guarantee.|Kellen to Bix Caleen|}} '''Council Three Hundred''' was a [[farm]]ing [[city|settlement]] on the agricultural world [[Mina-Rau]]. While discussing the movements of the [[Galactic Empire|Imperials]] conducting an [[Imperial Supply Census]] in [[4 BBY]],{{AndorDate|202}} [[Kellen]] informed [[Bix Caleen]], [[Talia (Mina-Rau)|Talia]], [[Brasso]] and [[Wilmon Paak]] over a meal that it looked like the [[Krole's contingent|contingent]] was headed to Three Hundred next. ==Behind the scenes== Council Three Hundred was mentioned during the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the [[Disney+]] live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', which was released on [[Disney+]] on [[April 22]], [[2025]].{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}} ==Appearances== *{{Andor|Sagrona Teema}} {{1stm}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=საბჭო სამასი }} [[Category:Mina-Rau locations]] [[Category:Settlements]]
